technology_name: DNA Vaccine Platform for Emerging Viruses
problem_solved: Escalding public health threats from multi-viral coinfections in tropical regions, combined with the instability and high distribution costs (cold-chain dependencies) of conventional vaccines.
description: A bivalent DNA vaccine platform engineered to deliver broad-spectrum protective immunity against two distinct viral pathogens via a single, combined formulation. The platform incorporates a specialized, in-house liposome-based lipid encapsulation formulation that protects the DNA payload, facilitates targeted cellular uptake, and enhances overall immunogenicity without the need for traditional viral vectors.
applications:
• Multivalent vaccines for tropical co-circulating viruses (e.g., Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika)

• Rapid-response vaccine manufacturing pipelines for emerging pandemic threats

• Custom liposomal encapsulation formulations for targeted genetic cargo delivery

• Low-cost veterinary multi-pathogen inoculation programs
